entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Bail application of the petitioner has been earlier rejected by this court vide B.A. No. 2501 of 2024 vide order dated 17.05.2024.
It is alleged that the petitioner was involved in cyber offence.

It is further alleged that at the time,
when the petitioner was apprehended, mobile phone was recovered from his possession which was used in cheating a victim.
Learned lawyer for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is in custody for more than a year.
It was finally submitted that similarly situated co-accused have been granted bail by this Court.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, the petitioner named above, is directed Umesh Ray vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
